title: Safe Decision-Making
description: This course teaches participants how to make decisions that prioritise safety, respect, and emotional wellbeing for everyone involved.
learningOutcomes: Learn how to make respectful, safe choices.

modules.title: Understanding Decision Impact
modules.content: Explores how choices affect partners and children.

modules.title: Unsafe Decision Patterns
modules.content: Identifies impulsive, coercive, or harmful decisions.

modules.title: Safe Decision Strategies
modules.content: Provides tools for thoughtful, respectful choices.
